title: AddTicketsToGithub
description: process-issues: add a run's tickets to a project as draft issues in one request. For n drafts (at least one) the operation declares $projectId: ID!, then $title<i>: String! and $body<i>: String! for each i from 0 to n-1 in ticket order, and holds one addProjectV2DraftIssue field per i, aliased draft<i> and using that pair of variables, each field on its own lines as `draft_field` in the GitHub client lays it out. The pattern fixes the shape of the text, so titles and bodies appear only as variable references; it cannot check that the indexes agree with each other and with the variables sent. Not idempotent, and not a transaction: some drafts may be created even if the request fails. A POST /graphql whose JSON body is this, exactly as sent: the operation text byte for byte, plus its variables (values are never written into the operation text). The token goes in the Authorization header with Accept: application/vnd.github+json and X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28.
